title: Product launch fragmented across functions
observations: Engineering, marketing, and operations use separate launch calendars.
Dependencies cross departmental boundaries but no role owns the interface.
Cross-functional issues remain unresolved until late-stage meetings.
Each unit reports its own milestones as on time.
participant_claims: Managers say teams need better communication.
researcher_interpretations: Structural fragmentation may create predictable coordination failures.
assumptions: More frequent meetings will solve the problem.
